answer.implementation_notes: The new CompactWithTombstones method differs from existing Compact in that: (1) it accepts a context.Context for cancellation support, (2) it takes []BlockMeta instead of directory paths (dirs []string), enabling in-memory metadata-driven compaction without filesystem lookups, (3) it accepts a tombstones.Reader to filter out deleted series during compaction rather than handling tombstones as a separate post-compaction step, and (4) it returns a single ulid.ULID instead of []ulid.ULID since tombstone-aware compaction produces exactly one output block. The implementation on LeveledCompactor should reuse the internal write/populateBlock logic (line 539/CompactWithBlockPopulator line 489) but integrate tombstone interval checking during series iteration.
